white-tank-waterfall.note: Main Trailhead Staging Area closed for construction through 8/31/26; Waterfall/Ford Canyon Trail remains open but is not reachable from the staging area during the closure. Source: Maricopa County Parks and Recreation.

browns-ranch.note: Brown's Ranch Trailhead closed since July 13, 2026 for improvement construction; no reopening date given. Source: City of Scottsdale McDowell Sonoran Preserve.

thunderbird-h3.note: 59th Avenue Trailhead closed for improvement construction through December 2026; trails remain open but require using the 55th Avenue or 67th Avenue trailheads instead. Source: City of Glendale Parks and Recreation.

devils-bridge.note: Both approaches (Dry Creek Road and Mescal Trailhead) closed under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

boynton-canyon.note: Access closed at the Dry Creek Road/Boynton Canyon Road junction under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

west-fork-oak-creek.note: Oak Creek Canyon (Call of the Canyon/West Fork) closed under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

soldier-pass.note: Soldier Pass Trailhead closed under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

bear-mountain.note: Bear Mountain Trailhead closed under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

fay-canyon.note: Fay Canyon Trailhead closed under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

mescal-courthouse.note: Mescal Trailhead and the Dry Creek Road corridor closed under the Pocket Fire closure order. Source: Coconino National Forest.

lava-river-cave.note: FR 171, the access road from FR 245 to the Lava River Cave trailhead, is closed to motorized vehicles for maintenance starting July 13, 2026; reaching the cave requires hiking or biking a longer unpaved approach. Source: Coconino National Forest (Forest Order 03-04-08-26-02).

fossil-springs.note: Fossil Creek Road closed indefinitely due to rockfall damage between Fossil Springs Trailhead and Waterfall Trailhead; the Strawberry-side approach is not accessible and access is limited to the Camp Verde/SR-260 side with a permit. Source: Coconino National Forest.

north-kaibab-coconino.note: Water is currently off at the North Kaibab Trailhead; hikers must carry sufficient water for the descent toward Coconino Overlook. Source: National Park Service, Grand Canyon National Park (trail conditions update, July 13, 2026).
